summary: Avalanche Treasury Corp filed an 8-K reporting a $10 million collateralized term loan from Galaxy Digital LLC, maturing January 10, 2027, with a 10.5% per annum borrow fee. The loan is secured by approximately 2.9 million AVAX tokens (180% initial collateral) held at Anchorage Digital Bank. Margin call provisions are set at 170% (initial), 165% (urgent), and 190% (refund). This is a routine financing agreement, not a special situation; the filing discloses entry into a material definitive agreement and creation of a direct financial obligation. No takeover, restructuring, or strategic event is involved.
